notes.title: Thank you for supporting Yet Another Hero Legend!
notes.notes:
The legend of the hero is not over yet. We decide to keep updating the game, adding new contents and designing more artwork for the game gradually.

If you are stuck in some level, or have nice ideas on designing new features or levels of the game, feel free to post on community center and share your ideas.

Yet Another Hero Legend is not just the game itself. Thank you for your help and support to make this game really grow.
